title: Help text for -a is wrong and -a 0 panics
body:
args.rs:355 says 'allow at most N attempts to recover disjoint clouds', which reads as retries on top of a first attempt. It is the total number of attempts. -a 0 reaches unreachable! at cloud_stage.rs:154 instead of an error.

Reword the help to say total attempts and reject 0 in SearchArgs::validate(). This cost an overnight cloud-search run.
